entries.title: Automatic tells you when no computer has the premium model you asked for
entries.body: When you ask for a premium model and no computer can run one right now, a task in a project set to Automatic now waits for premium allowance to come back, and Firstmate tells you so it can offer to start the task on a lesser model. The same goes for a task you asked to retry on a stronger model. Before, the task waited and Firstmate never heard. A project kept on This computer already worked this way.
entries.noPicture: What changes is that Firstmate hears of the wait and answers in its own words; the task itself shows the same Held mark a This computer task already shows.
